title: A p-value alone is not a Bayes factor
hook: Two stated cases: explore the prior odds in a stated Bayesian comparison.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the prior odds in a stated Bayesian comparison affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Posterior, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the prior odds in a stated Bayesian comparison in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy hypothesis has prior probability 0.01; evidence has likelihood ratio 10 in its favor. What is its posterior probability?
